subject: Escalation: MFN carveout + tiered discount request for StratoHealth pilot
messages:
From: Maya Srinivasan <maya_srinivasan@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elena Varga <elena@stratohealth.com>, StratoHealth Legal <legal@stratohealth.com>
Date: Tue, 27 Oct 2026 14:12:00 +0100
Subject: Escalation: MFN carveout + tiered discount request for StratoHealth pilot

Team — looping you in to request an executive exception for a strategic EU pilot with StratoHealth (healthcare analytics). Quick context and ask: 

- What they want: a limited MFN/benchmark clause that would trigger parity adjustments if we later sell materially better terms to comparable buyers; a 24-month regional exclusivity for our inference APIs in certain EU health markets; and a first-year, volume-tiered discount of 30% (with step-downs thereafter).
- Why it's high-risk: MFN/benchmark language + exclusivity could constrain pricing flexibility and create broad commercial precedent; discounts at 30% materially move our margin assumptions.
- Proposed commercial carve: Sales suggests a narrowly scoped MFN (only for the exact product SKU in the pilot, only against public benchmarked offers, and a narrow comparator list). Exclusivity to be limited to the pilot cohort (not company-wide) and to be non-binding / cancelleable if we expand features. Discount proposed as 30% Y1 for commitments > €500k, stepping to 15% in Y2.

Attachments: attaching the redlines we received (StratoHealth_Redlines_v3.pdf) and a quick revenue-impact scenario.

Ask: I need an official decision on whether we can: (1) accept a constrained MFN carveout, (2) approve an exclusivity clause for the pilot (and if so, for how long), and (3) approve the proposed tiered discount or propose an alternate cap.

If helpful, we can limit carveouts to a defined product SKU and require public-proof benchmarks + an explicit clause that any MFN adjustments are subject to a revenue cap and a written re-validation. Please advise with suggested language or approve the exceptions.

Next milestone: StratoHealth expects a signed SOW by Nov 10 to hit their pilot window.

Thanks,
Maya Srinivasan
Account Executive — Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Maya Srinivasan <maya_srinivasan@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elena Varga <elena@stratohealth.com>, StratoHealth Legal <legal@stratohealth.com>
Date: Tue, 27 Oct 2026 17:05:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Escalation: MFN carveout + tiered discount request for StratoHealth pilot

Thanks Maya — I reviewed the redlines. High level thoughts:

1) MFN / Benchmark: we cannot accept an open-ended MFN that references all "commercially reasonable" comparators. If we consider an MFN-like commitment, make it: (a) limited to the exact SKU(s) in scope, (b) limited to a pre-defined list of comparator product types (we should specify 3 named public comparators), and (c) subject to a maximum annualized revenue adjustment (suggestion: cap at €1.5M). Also add a lookback period (12 months) and require benchmarking evidence to be provided by the customer.

2) Exclusivity: we should not grant a company-wide exclusivity. If we accept anything, it should be a time-limited pilot-level exclusivity (12 months), with explicit carveouts for any public marketplace or OEM partners. Also include a performance-based termination (if they don't hit predefined adoption metrics, exclusivity terminates).

3) Discounts / Tiers: 30% is steep for a first-year commitment unless there is clear upside (≥ €1M ARR). Suggest approving up to 20% with a structured clawback tied to revenue/usage targets or future price normalization clauses.

Can finance run a margin impact scenario on the attached spreadsheet (copying Jonah for capacity) and propose a recommended maximum discount threshold.

If we want to pilot flexibility for a strategic logo, I'm open to constrained exceptions, but we need clearer guardrails in contract language. I drafted a short alternative clause in the redlines — see the PDF.

— Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Legal, Commercial
Redwood Inference

On Tue, 27 Oct 2026 at 14:12, Maya Srinivasan <maya_srinivasan@redwood.ai> wrote:

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Maya Srinivasan <maya_srinivasan@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Elena Varga <elena@stratohealth.com>
Date: Tue, 27 Oct 2026 18:12:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Escalation: MFN carveout + tiered discount request for StratoHealth pilot

Appreciate the context. A few pragmatic suggestions from deal desk / sales leadership POV: 

- Discounting: we should try to preserve list price integrity. Counter-proposal: approve an experimental discount schedule: 25% for Y1 on a committed minimum of €600k ARR with a structured step-down (15% Y2; re-evaluate at renewal). Include a usage-based clawback if usage is < 60% of committed units in Q2.
- MFN carveout: acceptable only if strictly SKU-scoped and with a monetary cap (Rishi's €1.5M cap sounds reasonable). Also require that any MFN-triggering comparator be publicly available and validated by our Pricing Ops.
- Exclusivity: strongly push to remove. If StratoHealth insists, limit to a 6–12 month pilot-exclusive clause, narrow product scope, and auto-terminate on missed adoption SLAs.

Please mark in the contract that any exception we grant is non-precedential — we must not set a template that sales can reuse.

Maya — if you can get StratoHealth to accept: (a) scoped MFN, (b) 25% max first-year discount with clawback, (c) pilot-only exclusivity of max 12 months and contingent on adoption — I'll support sending this to Marissa for exec signoff.

Jonas Weber
Director, Deal Desk & Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

On Tue, 27 Oct 2026 at 17:05, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai> wrote:

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Maya Srinivasan <maya_srinivasan@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elena Varga <elena@stratohealth.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Oct 2026 09:03:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Escalation: MFN carveout + tiered discount request for StratoHealth pilot

Thanks for the quick thread and the proposed guardrails. I'm comfortable approving an exception with the following non-negotiable conditions: 

1) MFN / Benchmark carveout: APPROVED only if strictly limited to the single product SKU "Inference API - Pilot SKU" and restricted to comparators that are publicly documented (no private customer benchmarks). Any financial adjustment from an MFN trigger must be capped at €1.25M lifetime (not annually). Require StratoHealth to submit benchmarking evidence within 30 days of any claim; Redwood retains sole right to validate.

2) Exclusivity: NOT APPROVED as written. We will offer a 6-month pilot-level exclusivity limited to the named SKU and the EU region with explicit performance gates (50% of committed usage by month 4) and an automatic termination clause if gates aren't met. No company-wide or product-line exclusivity.

3) Discounts: APPROVE up to 25% first-year discount on a minimum committed ARR of €600k with a quarterly clawback tied to usage and a one-time reconciliation at month 12. Any discounts above 25% require CFO sign-off (copy Finance).

4) Precedent language: Add a one-line non-precedent clause stating this approval is specific to StratoHealth and may not be cited as precedent for other deals.

Conditions to legal: integrate the caps and validation steps into the SOW and MFN clause (Rishi, please incorporate). Finance: rerun the margin scenario with the 25% / €1.25M cap and confirm impact to gross margin and payback assumptions.

Once legal sends the revised redline, Maya — push for StratoHealth to accept the constrained clause. If they refuse, we walk. If they accept, proceed to finalize SOW and schedule signature (target: Nov 10).

Marissa Cole
VP, Commercial Strategy & GTM
Redwood Inference
